Title: BOLA / IDOR on Order & Invoice Endpoint
Security/Financial Impact: CRITICAL: Public unauthenticated access to customer PII and invoice PDF
Recommended Fix: Require authentication and check user_id matching in OrderService
Required Tests: Unit test in OrderSecurityTest; Integration test for unauthorized GET /orders/id

Title: Overly Permissive CORS with Credentials
Root Cause: configuration.setAllowedOriginPatterns allows wildcard origins with setAllowCredentials(true)
Security/Financial Impact: HIGH: Arbitrary origins can execute authenticated cross-site requests
Recommended Fix: Restrict CORS allowed origins strictly to explicit production domain environment variables

Title: Schema Migration Drift (V31 Missing in Supabase)
Root Cause: V31 Flyway script was omitted from Supabase CLI migrations folder during SMS feature commit
Security/Financial Impact: HIGH: Deployment via Supabase CLI will fail with missing column exceptions

Title: Missing DB-Level Balance CHECK Constraint
Root Cause: wallets table lacks DB CHECK (available_balance >= 0) constraint
Security/Financial Impact: HIGH: Race condition could allow negative wallet balances if Java validator is bypassed
Recommended Fix: Add Flyway migration V32 adding CHECK (available_balance >= 0) on wallets table
Required Tests: Migration V32 test; concurrent wallet debit test

Title: Broken Frontend Lint Build Script
Root Cause: eslint package missing from devDependencies and missing ESLint config file
Security/Financial Impact: MEDIUM: Static analysis CI gate fails out of the box
Recommended Fix: Add eslint and eslint-plugin-react to devDependencies and create eslint config
Required Tests: Run npm run lint to verify zero errors

Title: Monolithic Frontend Component Bloat
Root Cause: Extreme single-file component size containing ~8500 lines of JSX
Security/Financial Impact: MEDIUM: High maintenance risk and brittle state re-render cascades
Recommended Fix: Decompose AdminDashboardPage into modular sub-components under src/components/admin/
Required Tests: Vite build and Vitest admin component tests

Title: Direct Browser Supabase SDK Exposure
Root Cause: Direct browser Supabase client initialized alongside Spring Boot REST APIs
Security/Financial Impact: MEDIUM: Potential backend security bypass if Postgres RLS is unaligned
Recommended Fix: Restrict Supabase client strictly to public read-only CDN media bucket access

Title: Unhandled Null Bean Warnings in Wallet Tests
Root Cause: WalletService logs null NotificationEventService errors during unit tests
Security/Financial Impact: LOW: Log noise during unit test execution
Required Tests: Run WalletServiceTest and verify log cleanliness

Title: Missing Swagger JWT Security Scheme
Root Cause: OpenApiConfig lacks @SecurityScheme annotations for JWT Bearer token
Security/Financial Impact: LOW: Interactive Swagger UI testing blocked for authenticated endpoints
Recommended Fix: Add @SecurityScheme definition for Bearer Auth in OpenApiConfig
Required Tests: Verify Swagger UI auth header input
